build: lean, moderately athletic — the kind that comes from intentional habits, not a gym obsession
skin_register: natural pores, minimal product sheen, faint periocular lines suggesting sustained focus — looks cared-for without looking treated
hair: short to medium length, clean cut with slight natural texture, dark brown with early salt at the temples — grown-out professional rather than styled
wardrobe: fitted mid-weight slate-grey merino crewneck or a pressed open-collar Oxford in muted white or stone — no logos, no performance fabric, no jewelry shimmer — the kind of piece that reads credentialed without reading corporate
accessories: Garmin Fenix or WHOOP band on left wrist, no rings, no visible chain — functional wearable signals self-quantification without ostentation
expression: mid-thought, eyes tracking slightly off-camera as if weighing a claim just encountered — mouth in a neutral-to-slight compression, not smiling, not closed off — the face of someone who is genuinely deciding something
body_language: weight slightly forward, chin level, shoulders settled and square — one hand near the chin or collarbone in a loose evaluative gesture, suggesting active internal processing rather than performance
register: authority-credentialed intellectual peer — calm skeptic in the moment before provisional endorsement
